1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

4593|ed01dd60.name: Christoph Walker
4593|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

3097-complete.name: Dark Cleric Duesten
3097-complete.text: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of Azeroth. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.
3097-complete.title: Hallowed Scroll

3097-progress.name: Dark Cleric Duesten
3097-progress.text:
Ah, so between fire, plague, rioting, and much worse, one more of the "faithful" comes to my door. Well, let me bid you welcome, $c. And allow me a moment to explain a thing or two before you decide it's time for you to seek whatever drives you forward: the Holy Light no longer concerns you, the spirits of your forefathers are fairy tales, and creatures from the Nether don't want you.

Do you understand me so far?
3097-progress.title: Hallowed Scroll
